title: What Haaland's home town did when Norway beat Brazil
originalTitle: What Haaland's home town did when Norway beat Brazil
content:
Watch how Erling Haaland's hometown of Bryne reacted to their hero scoring both goals as Norway knocked out Brazil to advance to the quarter-final of the World Cup. Rhodri Hywel reports.
